# FG-REPO-0016

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 503 |
| 重大度 | info |
| Runbook | なし |
| 発生させるテスト | `a_provisioning_repository_is_repository_not_ready` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: リポジトリの準備がまだ終わっていません。しばらくしてから再度お試しください。
- en: The repository is not ready yet. Try again in a moment.
- id: Repositori belum siap. Coba lagi sebentar lagi.

## 原因 (cause)

A Smart HTTP request (clone / fetch, M1 phase 9) reached a project whose repository is still in state `provisioning` (forge.repositories, step D4): the project exists and the caller may read it, but the provisioning job has not created the bare directory yet. Decided after authorize() allowed, so it never tells a caller who may not see the project that it exists.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The log event carries `repo_id`, `project_id`, `state` and `route`. A new project is normally ready within seconds. If the same repository keeps answering this, its provisioning is stuck: `forge doctor` reports it as FG-REPO-0012 (runbook repository-provisioning).

## 対処 (fix)

Wait a few seconds and retry. If it persists, follow FG-REPO-0012's runbook repository-provisioning (make sure a `forge worker` runs, read why the job died).
